PAYMENT_PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION_FIELDS.EN: Enter 0 when the Adyen merchant account captures immediately. Adyen then sends no capture notification, so without this a payment stays authorized and no invoice is issued. Leave blank if unsure.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION_FIELDS.IG: Ignored while methods are ticked above — Stripe rejects a checkout that names both, so the ticked list wins. Untick them all to use this instead.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION_FIELDS.LE: Leave every box unchecked to offer whatever the Stripe Dashboard enables, which is what this provider does today. A method marked one-off cannot be charged again later, so Stripe leaves it off a subscription’s first payment even when it is ticked here — it still appears on ordinary payments.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION_FIELDS.NU: Number of days after payment; 0 disables the age limit.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION_FIELDS.ON: Only set this when the provider account uses a store.
PAYMENT_PROVIDER_CONFIGURATION_FIELDS.OP: Optional. A configuration assembled in the Stripe Dashboard, used when no method is ticked above.
